description: DP-REPLAY-ENVIRON-01 dedicated-hull protocols for the diamond_princess_2020 pair. Carries the scheduled confinement order (SOP-017-DEDICATED) and its declared quarter-exempt variant (SOP-017-DEDQUARTER, DP-UNION-01) with diamond_princess zone IDs and the documented staggered crew-mess reference, and no reactive protocols: the protocol engine may only activate what this file declares. Distinct from protocols_covid_pf_dp.json (the boxed-meal diagnostic counterfactual), which stays untouched.

protocols.name: Diamond Princess Cabin Quarantine (2020-02-05)
protocols.description: Historical reference for DP-REPLAY-ENVIRON-01: cabin confinement of all passengers, essential-zone crew exempt, crew meals served in staggered mess seatings (the documented historical crew feeding mode; boxed delivery is the named diagnostic alternative in protocols_covid_pf_dp.json). Crew movement to work zones is granted by the rhythm layer's service_route commitments on the confinement variant (meal delivery, galley production, medical, service) — this file only declares who is exempt from the cabin rule and which zones remain work destinations. Trigger unreachable by design; activates only when a scenario schedule names it.

protocols.name: Diamond Princess Cabin Quarantine, 25% of Crew Exempt (DP-UNION-01 union arm)
protocols.description: DP-UNION-01 (docs/covid/covid_dp_union_01_design.md): verbatim SOP-017-DEDICATED with the exempt_work_zones list replaced by exempt_fraction - a sticky exact-count draw of one quarter of crew_general taken once at order activation on a dedicated RNG stream; drawn agents keep working, all others confine. The dedicated-hull re-declaration of the quarter-exempt lever QUAR-TAIL-SEAM-01 measured on boxed_s1s2 (SOP-017-QUARTERMB); the 0.25 headcount is that arm's declared reading of 'skeleton crew', Grade C, not fitted. Crew meals stay this hull's documented staggered four-seating mess; the boxed-meal declaration is not carried across hulls. Trigger unreachable by design; activates only when a scenario schedule names it.
